description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Katarina''' throws a Dagger at the target enemy that deals magic damage. Upon arrival, the Dagger also bounces to up to two additional [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|visible]] nearby enemies, dealing the same damage and travelling to bounce targets over 0.15 seconds each time.
description.text: Active: Katarina throws a Dagger at the target enemy that deals magic damage. Upon arrival, the Dagger also bounces to up to two additional visible nearby enemies, dealing the same damage and travelling to bounce targets over 0.15 seconds each time.

description2.raw: The Dagger lands 1.023 seconds after striking the first target, about 350 units opposite from their position when it struck them.
description2.text: The Dagger lands 1.023 seconds after striking the first target, about 350 units opposite from their position when it struck them.

leveling.raw:

80 / 115 / 150 / 185 / 220 (+ 40% AP)

notes.raw: * ''Bouncing Blade'' will not be destroyed in-flight if the target dies before reaching them but it will on [[File:Shaco Hallucinate 2.png|20px|link=Champion_summoned_units#decoys|An icon representing the keyword Clone]] [[:Champion_summoned_units#decoys|clones]] that expire. * If the Dagger's intended landing position is inside terrain it will instead land at the closest spot that isn't inside terrain. * Valid targets are determined after each bounce. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
notes.text:
Bouncing Blade will not be destroyed in-flight if the target dies before reaching them but it will on clones that expire.
If the Dagger's intended landing position is inside terrain it will instead land at the closest spot that isn't inside terrain.
Valid targets are determined after each bounce.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
